pages.title: Vigil
pages.text: Vigil is a treacherous maze of traps that demands constant awareness of your surroundings. Floating islands will drop anvils and stalactites on those beneath. Special $(bold)redstone nether bricks$(), barely distinct from normal red nether bricks, may trigger hidden TNT if stepped upon.

And even if you escape the explosions, they will draw the attention of typhlotic phantoms called $(bold)banshees$(). Banshees are normally content to coast above Vigil and ignore players, but something as loud and dramatic as an explosion will attract their ire - and this is $(italic)not$() a place where you want to be knocked off a ledge.
